task: Critique the regime-labeling pipeline used to train Cerberus autoresearch.
critique_themes: Cross-symbol calibration broken: median 94.3% HIGH/SHOCK on per-symbol parquets
Train/live estimator divergence (SMA+absolute vs Hurst+EWMA-z) with no documented invariant
Risk axis silently absent from training, silently present in live gating
81.9% accuracy is in-sample; possibly tautological if SPY truth shares labeler's threshold scheme
Symbol-class composition leaked as regime conditioning (top danger)
LOW-vol unreachable for 65 of 68 symbols — wrong-direction errors in low-vol-edge strategies
verdict: Conditional on a 30-minute consumption-pattern audit. If autoresearch joins per-symbol parquets (most likely given 69-file layout), labels are not usable as-is for non-SPY symbols and recent regime-conditioned non-SPY findings need a provisional flag. If autoresearch joins SPY-only, the 68 broken parquets are dead disk — delete and document.

p0: 30-min consumption audit: per-symbol vs SPY-only join; feature vs filter mode; activation: blocks keying on vol_regime/risk_state
Verify SPY ground truth construction: independently labeled or generated by labeler's own threshold scheme
Conditional: mark non-SPY regime-conditioned findings provisional (reversible metadata flag, not a promotion block)
p1: Build OOS multi-asset ground truth (4-6 hand-labeled periods spanning JNJ/TSLA/sector ETF/commodity ETF/SPY-not-in-original-8); score Labeler A AND Labeler B against same set
Information-content tests: MI of per-symbol vol_regime with forward 1-day return vs permutation null
Risk axis ultimatum: ship a real classifier (must hit Mar-2020/Jan-2022/SVB-Mar-2023/yen-Aug-2024 RISK_OFF on t±2 and ≥80% of unambiguous calm RISK_ON) or remove the axis
p2: Redesign Labeler A: vol_regime_market column (one shared state per date, absolute thresholds calibrated to benchmark) + vol_regime_symbol column (per-symbol percentile of trailing 252d distribution); estimator chosen by P1 ground truth; same estimator in train and live
Document REGIME_CONTRACT.md: axes, estimators, threshold derivation, hysteresis, train/live invariant
p3: Universe-aggregate CI checks on every labeler emit: (i) market-state column identical across symbols on common dates, (ii) <50% of universe in any single bin >80% of days, (iii) train/live agreement on market-state column for any common date in last 30 days
